subject: EU/APAC deployment drift — proposed safeguard and cutover window
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@finserve.de>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-27T09:05:00Z
Subject: EU/APAC deployment drift — proposed safeguard and cutover window

Hi Anna,

Quick follow after our sync last week — FinServe's security team asked for an explicit mitigation plan for potential routing drift between the EU control plane and the APAC private deployment during our upcoming configuration change. Before I draft the formal MAP, a couple of clarifying points would help us: 

- Do you have an existing maintenance window preference for control-plane updates that touch routing (e.g., weekends, 00:00–04:00 CET)?
- For APAC-hosted clusters, can you confirm the on-prem network team will provide non-overlapping CIDR hints for the standby region?
- Any regulatory blackout dates in Q2 (reporting windows) we should avoid?

We want to propose a short, staged cutover (probe-only, validation, traffic switch, fallback) and a short-lived guard route (prefix limited to test prefixes) to ensure no cross-border egress occurs unintentionally. I can circulate a one-page MAP and an operations checklist for signoff.

Thanks,
Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0199

Note: I will loop in Karthik (network) and Soojin (ops) to scope implementation details on our side.
From: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@finserve.de>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: APAC Hosting Team <apac-cloud@hoster.example>
Date: 2028-03-27T11:18:00Z
Subject: Re: EU/APAC deployment drift — proposed safeguard and cutover window

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for raising this. Short answers to your bullets: 

- Maintenance window: preference is Saturday 02:00–06:00 CET; we can do Friday night for minimal business impact but prefer Saturday.
- APAC CIDR: APAC networking team will reserve 10.240.0.0/12 for standby; confirmed they will not overlap with EU ranges.
- Blackout dates: there is an earnings prep freeze from 2028-04-20 to 2028-04-27 — avoid that.

I've attached a zone mapping we maintain for cross-border peering and a quick SOC2 snapshot our compliance team shared. I can also ask our infra lead to pre-stage firewall rules to accept the short guard prefixes you mentioned.

Anna

--
Anna Schmidt
Head of Cloud Architecture, FinServe GmbH
anna.schmidt@finserve.de
+49 30 555 4821

Attachments:
- eu-apac-zone-mapping.svg (diagram)
- SOC2-snapshot-2027.pdf (summary)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@finserve.de>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-27T12:02:00Z
Subject: Re: EU/APAC deployment drift — proposed safeguard and cutover window

Thanks Anna — very helpful. Karthik / Soojin / Marissa,

Per Anna: Saturday 02:00–06:00 CET looks like our target. The high-level MAP I propose: 

1) Probe-only (30 min): announce small test prefixes from EU control plane, verify APAC accepts via pre-staged firewall openings.
2) KV-prefix cache validation (15 min): ensure prefix exchange does not cause KV cache write-through to APAC tenants flagged for EU-only.
3) Traffic switch (30 min): move 5% -> 25% -> 100% with health checks and circuit-level telemetry.
4) Fallback (15 min): rollback to previous routing + purge temporary guard prefixes.

Operational asks for Redwood side:
- Karthik: prepare route-announce scripts that can be executed by ops and include a dry-run mode.
- Soojin: ensure we have a canary metric dashboard (latency by region, egress counters by tenant residency tag) and a rollback runbook stub.
- Marissa: we may need a short legal acceptance (single-paragraph) acknowledging the temporary guard prefixes and operational rollback SLA for FinServe.

Anna — are you comfortable with the phasing above? If so I'll upload the MAP workbook and schedule the cutover window with your infra team for the weekend of 2028-04-07.

Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@finserve.de>
Date: 2028-03-27T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: EU/APAC deployment drift — proposed safeguard and cutover window

Hi team — quick note from legal and compliance side: 

We can approve the single-paragraph operational acceptance for temporary guard prefixes under two conditions: 

1) FinServe confirms the guard prefixes will be limited in scope and duration (we should list the exact prefixes and an expiry timestamp in the MAP).
2) Redwood provides a documented fallback SLA: timeline for rollback and notification cadence if the canary fails.

If you draft the MAP with these items called out I can expedite signoff to a 24-hour turnaround. Also, attach the SOC2 snapshot (Anna) to the acceptance memo — helps our compliance team validate control equivalence.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@finserve.de>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, APAC Hosting Team <apac-cloud@hoster.example>
Date: 2028-03-28T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: EU/APAC deployment drift — proposed safeguard and cutover window

Jordan / Marissa,

Confirmed — APAC infra will reserve the standby CIDR and accept the temporary announcements. Attached is a small workbook (redwood-finserve-map-mvp-map.xlsx) listing the exact test prefixes we suggest (10.241.240.0/24, 10.241.241.0/24) and a proposed expiry timestamp of 2028-04-08T08:00:00Z for automatic withdraw.

We are good to target the weekend of 2028-04-07 (Saturday 02:00 CET) provided Redwood circulates the MAP with the rollback SLA (max 15 minutes to rollback after automated failure threshold) and the brief legal acceptance.

Attaching: redwood-finserve-map-mvp-map.xlsx

Anna

--
Anna Schmidt
Head of Cloud Architecture, FinServe GmbH
